correctness.rationale: Each numerator-two odd greedy expansion has even finite length. The first remainder numerator is exactly 1 or 3; in the three-branch if 3 does not divide the denominator, greedy remainders successively have numerators 4 and 5. Odd-denominator conditions imply D ≡ 7 mod 8; four-term termination reduces to A ≡ 0,1 mod5, and A ≡1 is excluded by nonsquare discriminant 2. CRT gives exactly four classes mod60; all other classes and density and sharp period follow. This unrestricted proof covers q odd >=3, and 10,000 exact arithmetic tests corroborate it.
